caveat: Official series; open data within 2% of OPCD every year. Plateau 2023-2024 only (field stops 2025-07). Reform was a city rights change in 2019, not a state mandate; market far above Wisconsin.
method: Primary: OPCD 2024 ADU Annual Report Exhibit 10 (official; units permitted by issue year, AADU+DADU, includes ADUs built with new houses and on condo parcels; no legalization screen). Cross-check: SDCI Building Permits (data.seattle.gov 76t5-zqzr), permittypemapped=Building, dwellingunittype contains 'Accessory Dwelling', issued, not void; units = ADU types listed / housingunitsadded; with-new-house = SFD/townhouse also listed on a 'New' permit; legalization by text.

caveat: Clean flagged open data since 1995. Changes were fee-driven (SDC waiver) then RIP; the 2023-2025 level is after a peak-and-decline, so it is not a post-mandate plateau comparable with California's.
method: BDS Residential Building Permits (PortlandMaps open data layer 89: permits creating >=1 unit since 1995), IS_ADU=True, PDXBND=YES, ISSUEDATE year; detached = New Construction of NEWTYPE ADU; conversion/attached = Alteration/Addition; with-new-house = New Construction of a house flagged IS_ADU; 1 ADU per permit; legalization by text (FOLDER_DES).

caveat: ADU category retired by HOME on 2024-02-05, so the 2023-2025 window has one year (2023). Most secondary apartments are built with a new house (same-parcel match, a heuristic). Attached vs detached not coded.
method: Issued Construction Permits (data.austintexas.gov 3syk-w9eu), permittype BP, permit_class 'R- 102 Secondary Apartment', full/limited purpose, not VOID/Withdrawn, calendar issue year; units = housing_units (1-2); with-new-house = R-101 permit on the same TCAD parcel within 365 days; legalization by text. Category retired by HOME (2024-02-05): 2024+ not comparable.

caveat: Statistics code 026 is reliable for detached ADUs; conversions/attached are under-identified and legalizations cannot be screened (no text). 2023-2025 mixes zone-by-zone legality with one citywide year.
method: Residential Construction Permits (Denver Open Data, Accela RESCON, ArcGIS layer 316), building statistics code 026 (ADU) on any of STAT_CODE_1-3, not cancelled, excluding change-of-contractor/repair/move; detached = New Building, attached/conversion = Addition/Alteration/Change of Use; with-new-house = 026 with a dwelling code 001/002; no description field, so no legalization screen. Complete from 2016 (Accela went live 2015-06-07).

caveat: Closest Midwest analogue. Text-matched permits, de-duplicated per parcel; data start Dec 2016 so no pre-2014 baseline. Small counts (13-16 a year).
method: CCS Permits (opendata.minneapolismn.gov, ArcGIS CCS_Permits/0), permitType Res whose comments mention an ADU, one ADU per parcel (APN) per 24 months; records start 2016-12; legalization by text; with-new-house = New SFD/TFD.
